name: ssm_parameter
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Parameter Store parameter, provisioned within an environment and resource group. Every in-place update rewrites the value, so it creates a new parameter version.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this parameter.

attributes.name: name
attributes.patternDescription: must be a simple name (e.g. db-host) or a hierarchical path starting with / (e.g. /myapp/dev/db-host), using lowercase letters, digits, periods, underscores and hyphens, with no empty or trailing path segments
attributes.description: Parameter name: a simple name such as `db-host`, or a hierarchical path that starts with `/`, such as `/myapp/dev/db-host`. Lowercase only, because the platform stores names in lowercase. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the parameter is created.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the parameter is created. Its AWS account and region are used.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Parameter type: String (plain text), StringList (comma-separated values, plain text) or SecureString (encrypted with AWS KMS). Changing the type of an existing parameter is not supported yet: a change after creation is not applied. To change it, replace the parameter (e.g. `terraform apply -replace=<address>`).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Parameter value. For StringList, a comma-separated list such as `a,b,c`. Refreshed from AWS (decrypted for SecureString), so a change made outside Terraform shows as drift; if AWS cannot be read, the value already in state is kept. The value is stored in Terraform state.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description stored on the parameter in AWS. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current description.

attributes.name: key_id
attributes.description: SecureString only. KMS key that encrypts the value: a key ID, ARN or alias. Defaults to the AWS-managed key `alias/aws/ssm`. Updating the key of an existing parameter is not supported yet: a change after creation is ignored and the parameter keeps its original key. To use a different key, replace the parameter (e.g. `terraform apply -replace=<address>`).

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Storage tier: Standard (values up to 4 KB, free), Advanced (up to 8 KB, charged) or Intelligent-Tiering (AWS picks Standard or Advanced on each write). Defaults to Standard. With Intelligent-Tiering, AWS reports the tier it resolved to; that is not shown as a change, so a tier changed outside Terraform is not detected while Intelligent-Tiering is configured. Changing Advanced back to Standard fails at apply because AWS does not allow it; replace the parameter instead (e.g. `terraform apply -replace=<address>`).

attributes.name: allowed_pattern
attributes.description: Regular expression that AWS checks the value against on every write, e.g. `^\d+$` for digits only. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current pattern.

attributes.name: data_type
attributes.description: Data type AWS validates the value as: text (default), aws:ec2:image (an AMI ID) or aws:ssm:integration.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the parameter at creation. Platform ownership tags and the resource group's tags are added automatically. Set only at creation (SSM does not accept tags when a parameter is updated).

attributes.name: ssm_parameter_id
attributes.description: ID of this parameter, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: arn
attributes.description: ARN of the parameter in AWS.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current parameter version. AWS increments it on every write.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: When the parameter was last written (RFC 3339, UTC, second precision).

invalidWhen.message: key_id only applies to type = "SecureString": String and StringList parameters are not encrypted. Remove key_id, or set type = "SecureString".
